rules: Every job must succeed, including all soak, extended, forward-compatibility and fuzz gates.
Audit execution receipts for every discovered fuzz target against the exact source revision and requested iteration floor.
Manual workflow_dispatch and local runs are never scheduled confidence cycles.
A missed or failed daily scheduled run breaks the consecutive streak.
Relevant runtime, generator, test, dependency or gate changes reset qualifying evidence.
Evidence-only documentation updates do not reset the native runtime confidence streak.
